s1.syndrome_frame: Facial asymmetry with a cerebellopontine angle mass and hearing loss in an infant
salient_findings: Enhancing mass in the left cerebellopontine angle and internal auditory canal
Profound hearing loss in the left ear
key_facts: 4-week-old male patient
Left facial asymmetry observed during crying
Passed infant hearing screening
MRI showed an enhancing mass in the left cerebellopontine angle and internal auditory canal
Follow-up MRI showed considerable growth of the mass
ABR testing demonstrated profound hearing loss in the left ear
Histopathological examination revealed a vascular lesion with low levels of mitotic activity
Biphasic lesion composed of vascular nodules among spindle cells
Glomeruloid-like architecture of vascular epithelial nodules

raw.syndrome_frame: Facial asymmetry with a cerebellopontine angle mass and hearing loss in an infant
salient_findings: Enhancing mass in the left cerebellopontine angle and internal auditory canal
Profound hearing loss in the left ear
key_facts: 4-week-old male patient
Left facial asymmetry observed during crying
Passed infant hearing screening
MRI showed an enhancing mass in the left cerebellopontine angle and internal auditory canal
Follow-up MRI showed considerable growth of the mass
ABR testing demonstrated profound hearing loss in the left ear
Histopathological examination revealed a vascular lesion with low levels of mitotic activity
Biphasic lesion composed of vascular nodules among spindle cells
Glomeruloid-like architecture of vascular epithelial nodules

differentials: epidermoid cyst in the cerebellopontine angle

raw.rationale: The patient's left facial asymmetry observed during crying and the presence of a mass in the left cerebellopontine angle and internal auditory canal, which can affect the facial nerve, support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: profound hearing loss
rejected.why: While the patient has profound hearing loss in the left ear, this is a symptom rather than the primary diagnosis.

rejected.label: hearing loss
rejected.why: Too general, as it does not specify the type or cause of the hearing loss.

rejected.label: sensorineural hearing loss
rejected.why: Although the patient's hearing loss is likely sensorineural given the location of the mass, this diagnosis does not account for the facial asymmetry.

rejected.label: facial asymmetry
rejected.why: This is a symptom rather than a diagnosis, and facial palsy better explains the underlying cause of the asymmetry.

rejected.label: facial asymmetry
rejected.why: Already considered in the champion diagnosis as facial palsy
